title: The Statue of Liberty: ‘Enlightening the World’ for Nearly 150 Years
summary: Францаас бэлэглэсэн Эрх чөлөөний хөшөө хэрхэн бүтээгдэж, Нью-Йоркт ирсэн түүх.

source.name: VOA Learning English
source.credit: Jerry Watson, Anna Matteo · VOA Learning English
source.creditLine: Jerry Watson wrote this story, and Anna Matteo adapted it for VOA Learning English.

questions.prompt: Who gave the Statue of Liberty to the United States?
questions.explain: "Lady Liberty ... was a gift from the people of France" гэж бичсэн.

questions.prompt: In how many pieces did the statue travel to New York?
questions.explain: "Workers separated the statue into 350 pieces" гэж бичсэн. 200 гэдэг нь модон хайрцагны тоо.

questions.prompt: What do the seven points on the crown represent?
options: Freedom shining on the seas and continents
The seven people who built the statue
The seven years of work on the statue
questions.explain: "Each point is meant to represent the light of freedom as it shines on the seven seas and seven continents" гэж тайлбарласан.

changes: A duplicated caption line about the pedestal removed.
